<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks between ~110‑160 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. Counting each peak in that range (excluding the carbonyl at 166.40 ppm and the aliphatic carbon at 52.24 ppm) gives 16 aromatic carbon signals, representing 16 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>16</final_answer>
